Prefetch threshold theory (Dahlin; Srinath/Mutlu 40% rule): prefetch pays only when P(used) > theta* ~= 0.38-0.64 at our rates — KILLS naive router-prior prefetch under the flat distribution (per-expert P~0.21) but a conditioned cross-layer predictor (~90% literature accuracy) clears the bar; chunk-capped speculation + Do-No-Harm eviction (Cao 4 rules) makes it <=2x off offline-optimal.

N. Noise-shaping/beta-encoding quantization (Chou-Gunturk; Lybrand-Saab): the ONE quantization family whose guarantee survives a flat spectrum (redundancy source = over-parameterization, not spectral decay); reaches the RD limit cheaply with a sequential/streaming decoder.

F13_kvdecide_2026_07_26.instrumentation: DS4_KV_DECIDE_LOG (binary e709f4734814) logs why each request does/doesn't reuse state: cached, source, live length, prompt length, common-prefix length
F13_kvdecide_2026_07_26.decisive_line: KVDECIDE cached=0 source=none live=5063 prompt=5066 common=5045 kv_enabled=1 min_tokens=512
mechanism_identified: 1. The appended prompt's tokens DIVERGE FROM THE LIVE SESSION at position 5045 even though its TEXT is base+generated+append. Cause: BPE re-merge at the junction — tokenizing the concatenated text yields different tokens near the boundary than (base tokens + sampled generation tokens). This is why live reuse always misses: common=5045 < live=5063.

2. After that miss, a disk-KV load is what supplies the resume. In ttft_append_probe.sh a base checkpoint EXISTED on disk, so the server loaded the 5044-token file and resumed with a 22-token suffix — the regime that diverges. In my three reproduction harnesses no such checkpoint was present (no 'kv cache stored' line in this run), so the append cold-prefilled and matched cold exactly.
3. This explains all five experiments coherently: divergence appears if and only if a disk checkpoint is loaded and then extended by a long suffix.
F13_kvdecide_2026_07_26.reproduction_recipe_now_known: prime the disk store (base request, verify a 'kv cache stored' line appears), keep KVDIR intact, then fire the append in a process whose live session mismatches — the server will disk-load and resume with a long suffix. Only then is the tagged logit pair valid.
